group.name: delete_plugin
group.title: Delete Plugin Settings
group.description: Control how the Delete Plugin finds the files of a plugin before they are removed.

settings.name: scan_mode
settings.title: Scan Mode
settings.description: Balanced: every file owned by the plugin folder is found, plus name-matched files whose content really references the plugin. Strict: only the plugin folder plus files that plugin code actually loads (require/include) are found.

settings.name: excluded_paths
settings.title: Protected Paths
settings.description: One path per line, relative to the forum root. A folder entry protects the whole tree. Wildcards are allowed (for example uploads/* or *.log). Protected paths are never deleted, whatever plugin code says.
settings.value:
inc/plugins/temp
Backup Plugins
admin/backups
uploads
.git
node_modules

settings.name: included_paths
settings.title: Extra Paths To Delete
settings.description: One path per line, relative to the forum root. These folders or files are always treated as part of the plugin even when they live outside the plugin folder. Use it when a plugin keeps assets or admin pages somewhere else.

settings.name: include_root_scripts
settings.title: Include Root Scripts
settings.description: Find entry scripts placed in the forum root (for example sw.js or store.php) when they really belong to the plugin. A file must reference the plugin folder or use the plugin prefix. Leave this off to keep deletion limited to the plugin area.

settings.name: max_file_size
settings.title: Maximum File Size (KB)
settings.description: Never delete a single file larger than this size in kilobytes. Set to 0 to allow every file. The plugin entry file is always listed, whatever its size.

settings.name: show_skipped
settings.title: Show Protected Files
settings.description: List the files that will be left on disk, together with the reason each one is kept.

settings.name: run_uninstall
settings.title: Run Uninstall By Default
settings.description: Pre-tick the "Run the plugin uninstall routine" box on the scan page. The uninstall routine removes database tables and other data the plugin created.

settings.name: remove_data
settings.title: Remove Templates And Settings By Default
settings.description: Pre-tick the box that removes the plugin template groups and settings groups through PluginLibrary after the files are gone.

settings.name: prune_folders
settings.title: Remove Empty Folders By Default
settings.description: Pre-tick the box that removes the plugin folders once every file inside them is gone.
